blocks.raw: <Tip>To remember the MDPE formula, use the acronym DOPN: Direct Personnel Expense, Overhead, Profit, and Non-technical factors. The total fee equals DPE times (1 plus Overhead% plus Profit% plus Non-technical%). Practice with the decomposition examples until it becomes second nature.</Tip>

blocks.raw: <ExamTip>On the LEA, MDPE multiplier questions typically test understanding of the fee calculation structure rather than specific multiplier values. Be prepared to identify which components make up the multiplier (overhead, profit, non-technical factors), explain how to derive a multiplier from firm financial data, and compare MDPE with percentage-of-PCC methods. Computation questions may ask you to calculate a fee given DPE and multiplier components.</ExamTip>
